review.instruction: Reproduce the supplied finding before the change and verify the same state after it. Require concrete rendered or behavioral evidence; source intent is insufficient.
Inspect baseline and result pixels together. The approved composition, hierarchy, spacing system and unaffected states must remain intact; reject a broader redesign.
Inspect the diff. It must answer one finding, touch only declared existing files, stay within the size ceiling, and introduce no new path, product behavior or UI authority value.
Run the unchanged targeted proof plus declared dependent checks. Require raw command or browser evidence with no failed result.

failurePolicy: Reproduce, repair, render and reassess. Feedback identifies the precise remaining defect or regression; repair only its owning lines. Delete rejected captures and retain concise failure metadata plus accepted evidence.
